E01.title: Personal outcomes and graduation
E01.purpose: Give each person a concrete chosen outcome and a recognizable endpoint, with a comfortable independence handover.

E02.title: Need-based entry and useful first result
E02.purpose: Route immediate needs to a complete useful result before wider exploration.

E03.title: Capacity-sensitive experience
E03.purpose: Let explicit available-capacity choices change effort, density and interaction length.

E04.title: Discriminating insight questions
E04.purpose: Ask neutral questions whose answers change a useful interpretation or next action.

E05.title: Useful action under uncertainty
E05.purpose: Help people act modestly when explanations remain uncertain and collect useful observations.

E06.title: Corrections that propagate
E06.purpose: Carry user corrections into relevant summaries, coach context and memory with visible change and undo.

E07.title: Contextual validity of personal knowledge
E07.purpose: Let people mark observations still fitting, context-specific or no longer fitting.

E08.title: Transfer-centered learning
E08.purpose: Help a chosen move survive new constraints and progressively lighter guidance.

E09.title: Satisfying adaptation feedback
E09.purpose: Acknowledge revising, noticing exceptions, requesting help and choosing rest truthfully.

E10.title: Play with meaningful consequences
E10.purpose: Use rearrangement, comparison and practical constraints to make choices legible and enjoyable.

E11.title: Recognizable Felt dramatic roles
E11.purpose: Develop coherent character personality, humor, gestures and recurrence around chosen activities.

E12.title: Beautiful quiet and accessible presentation
E12.purpose: Give static, text, list and assistive-technology experiences equal craft and useful context.

E13.title: Universal interaction grammar
E13.purpose: Make choosing, inspecting, saving, undoing, pausing and returning predictable across domains.

E14.title: Tools useful outside the app
E14.purpose: Provide discreet exports and optional shortcuts for the user-selected practical tool.

E15.title: Human-session continuity
E15.purpose: Connect selective preparation, booking, chosen questions and agreed next steps.

E16.title: Therapist analysis of disagreement
E16.purpose: Expose differences between instruments, contexts and time without false precision.

E17.title: Understandable reliability
E17.purpose: Keep saving, sending, offline behavior, conflicts and recovery understandable at use time.

E18.title: Physical-device comfort and economy
E18.purpose: Validate sustained responsiveness, battery/heat, large text and repeated scene use.

E19.title: Extensions that earn complexity
E19.purpose: Compare each signature or experimental extension with a simpler complete alternative.

E20.title: Independent multidimensional evaluation
E20.purpose: Evaluate comprehension, usefulness, correction, enjoyment, access and transfer independently.

A01.title: Scope, inventory and immutable baseline
steps: Pin AAA v7.1 draft source hash, adoption claims and optional-profile exclusions
Inventory React, retained Angular, worker, CI and deployable boundaries
Reconcile dirty source into a reviewable immutable implementation baseline
Inventory authoritative state, effects, concrete imports and mutable hotspots
Capture dependency graph and applicable baseline verification evidence
Publish proposed component ownership and central integration hotspots
Independently review source mapping and migration blast radius
Accept baseline and issue unresolved inventory follow-ups

A02.title: Constitution, authority and risk
steps: Specify hard coordinate, consent, ownership, entitlement and truthful-state invariants
Define forbidden authority expansion and producer/evaluator/deployer/evidence separation
Classify M0–M4 and R0–R4 with app-specific examples and maximum-risk rule
Define workcell capability ceiling and secret-free default execution
Define legitimate state and bounded recovery targets for declared failures
Specify independently controlled constitution-change and R4 activation procedures
Verify invariant fixtures, authority denials and risk-selection examples
Ratify proposed constitution through the scoped governance authority

A03.title: Beads workplan and conflict compiler
steps: Define workplan schema for base, reads, writes, slots, contracts, outputs and risk
Build Beads-to-workplan export retaining tracker as task authority
Compile predecessor DAG and separate symmetric conflict graph
Detect path overlap, owned-slot overlap and incompatible contract transitions
Plan a ready antichain against available execution slots and live leases
Explain rejected pairings and contract-change fanout prerequisites
Verify scheduler on cycles, overlapping paths, pinned reads and stale contracts
Publish compiler compatibility contract and independently reviewed workplan

A04.title: Isolated workcells and leases
steps: Specify isolation for checkout, dependencies, caches, builds, fixtures and emulators
Implement workcell creation pinned to immutable base and narrow capabilities
Allocate independent output paths, ports and emulator project namespaces
Implement acquire, renew, expire and release for write and slot leases
